sn_aia_usecase.base_plan: This agentic workflow specializes in evaluating and processing duty travel requests efficiently and accurately. 1. Review submitted duty travel details for completeness and accuracy. 2. Check destination for current travel alerts or advisories. 3. Analyze the traveler's historical travel request approval status. 4. Align travel request information with company travel policies and guidelines including eligible cabin class and travel alert policies. 5. Make an AI-driven decision to approve, reject, or escalate the request for executive approval.
sn_aia_usecase.description: This workflow automates the review and decision-making process for duty travel requests. It is designed for travel coordinators and approvers, ensuring requests comply with company policies and safety alerts while considering the traveler's history.
sn_aia_usecase.name: Duty Travel Fulfillment
